auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    d.XCL_038 AS driver_name,
    r.XCL_083 AS points
FROM 
    results r
JOIN 
    drivers d ON r.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
JOIN 
    races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
JOIN 
    seasons s ON ra.XCL_066 = s.XCL_091
WHERE 
    s.XCL_091 = 2017
    AND ra.XCL_069 = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
ORDER BY 
    r.XCL_083 DESC
LIMIT 3
